lead.headline: Las Vegas Sands reported $20.58M in Texas lobby "media" spending, 2021-26: 2.5 times all other lobbyists combined
lead.number: $20,575,810.66 over 62 monthly reports by one lobbyist, Andy Abboud, May 2021-Jun 2026: 70-71% of all Texas lobby media (everyone else $8.26M), about 4x Sands' ~$5.1M federal lobby fees in the same months
lead.watch_out: Abboud is a Sands employee (general knowledge, unchecked), so this may be Sands' own ad campaign filed under his name; don't write "a lobbyist spent."

sources.quote: Las Vegas Sands ended up spending as much as $6.3 million on lobbying at the Capitol, according to state records, plus what the company pegged as at least $2 million on a statewide ad campaign.
Las Vegas Sands Corp. (LVS) spent between $10 milli0n and $20 million in recent months to promote gambling legislation in Texas.
The gaming empire Las Vegas Sands is launching a multimillion-dollar advertising blitz to build support for its campaign to bring casinos to Texas.
The latest number works out to between $2.3 million to $4.5 million spent on lobbyists by the company, based on information from the Texas Ethics Commission.
They ran an expensive, nonstop TV advertising campaign that probably most of your listeners saw at some point.
